name: Akane Rin
source:
The protagonist of Ayakashi Gohan if the player decides to play the routes in the "Human Chapters". 

Rin is mild-mannered and reserved. She tries not to get involved with others as much as possible. She doesn't like eating with others.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_rinA.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
